promotional_text: Transform any camera into a professional studio with AI-powered scene analysis and automatic settings optimization. Perfect for beginners and pros alike!
description:
**Professional Photography Made Simple with AI**

Transform your camera into a professional tool with Camera Companion - the intelligent photography assistant that makes expert-level photos accessible to everyone.

**🤖 AI-Powered Intelligence**
• Smart scene recognition for portraits, landscapes, sports & macro
• Automatic camera settings optimization (ISO, aperture, shutter speed)
• Real-time photography tips and recommendations
• Advanced NeRF-based 3D scene analysis for perfect focus

**📱 Universal Camera Control**
• Wireless control for Canon, Sony, Nikon, Fujifilm cameras
• Live view streaming with <200ms latency
• Remote capture with full parameter control
• Professional style presets ("Creamy Portrait", "Vivid Landscape")

**🎓 Learn While You Shoot**
• Interactive photography tutorials for all skill levels
• Plain-language camera setting explanations
• Before/after examples showing setting impacts
• Contextual help based on your shooting scenario

**☁️ Seamless Workflow**
• Automatic cloud backup and sync across devices
• Smart photo organization and management
• Social sharing with AI-optimized compression
• Cross-platform compatibility (iOS/Android)

**✨ Advanced Features**
• Multi-brand camera detection and optimization
• Learning system that adapts to your style
• Background sync with offline support
• Professional-grade manual controls

**Perfect for:**
• Photography enthusiasts wanting to improve their skills
• Beginners learning camera settings and techniques
• Professionals needing reliable remote camera control
• Content creators seeking consistent, high-quality results

**Supported Cameras:**
Canon (EOS R series, 5D Mark IV, 6D Mark II), Sony (α7 series, α6000 series), Nikon (Z series, D850, D780), Fujifilm (X-T series, X-H series), and more.

Download Camera Companion today and discover how AI can transform your photography journey from amateur to professional.
release_notes:
🚀 Major Performance Update!

• 75% faster AI analysis with improved accuracy
• Enhanced WebSocket streaming with 30 FPS frame rate limiting
• Reduced memory usage by 60% for better device performance
• New HTTP request batching for 80% faster settings updates
• Fixed Sony camera connectivity issues
• Improved timeout handling prevents app freezing
• Better error handling and user feedback

This update makes Camera Companion faster, more reliable, and more efficient than ever. Your photography workflow just got a major upgrade!

app_review_information.notes: This app requires a compatible camera (Canon, Sony, Nikon, Fujifilm) for full functionality. Demo mode available without camera for testing core features.
